notes.title: Horror Night v1.0.0 - In Development
notes.content:
Horror Night v1.0.0 - In Development

We are excited to announce that we are currently in the development process for Horror Night version 1.0.0. We want to ensure that all game details are finely polished, and the gameplay mechanics are enjoyable for you and your friends. Here are the changes you can expect in this version:

Graphics Engine Change: We are migrating the game from the Unity graphics engine to Unreal Engine 5 to enhance compatibility and the lighting experience.

Improved Online System: We are working on a new online system with better response time and a latency compensation system, which should result in a smoother online experience.

Random Map Hunt Edition: We have introduced random maps for Asymmetric Hunt mode to add variety and excitement to each match.

Expanded Survivor Edition Story Modes: We are expanding the Survivor Edition story modes to provide longer and higher-quality cinematic experiences.

New Villains: We are adding new villains to the game to challenge players with fresh and thrilling threats.

New Map: We will be introducing a new map, expanding the game world with unique environments and challenges.

New Player Characters: We are working on new player characters that will bring unique abilities and perspectives to diversify gameplay options.

We are committed to making Horror Night an outstanding gaming experience. Stay tuned for future updates as we will notify you when version 1.0.0 is ready for release. Get ready for an exciting and enhanced gaming experience!

notes.title: 0.9.15 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2][b]0.9.15 UPDATE - New DLC:  [i]The Slenderman Takings[/i][/b][/h2]

[h3][b]The new DLC includes:[/b][/h3]

[b]New Map:[/b] [i]The Forest[/i], with camping areas, cemetery, sawmill, and a dock.
[b]New Killer:[/b] [i]Slenderman[/i], with the ability of teleportation to surprise and stalk its victims.
[b]New survivor skill:[/b] [i]"walkie-talkie"[/i], use it carefully to stun the Slenderman (it will take a few moments to allow you to use it again).
[b]New cemetery puzzle:[/b] help the undead to find his body parts and get out of the cemetery.
[b]New exit by the dock:[/b] activate the motor boat to escape!

[h3][b]Asymmetric Mode (pvp):[/b][/h3]
You'll be able to hunt your firends down [i]as the Slenderman[/i], with a new ability of teleportation to stalk your victims.
[b]Steam Achievements:[/b] Escape the Slenderman to earn new achievements.
[b]New skin available[/b] (for the Slenderman): [i]Slendycrow[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232677/a8eb8d33096467b99c69f9502433f54d410d2ce3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Optimization and Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
Improvements in lights, graphics and textures, [i]for better performance.[/i]

notes.title: HORROR NIGHT IS COMING!!!
notes.content:
Horror Night is an Online Multiplayer Coop Third/First person asymmetric horror adventure game. You have to escape the monster, in a procedurally generated scenario by solving puzzles and finding items, alongside your teammates. Characters can be customized through cosmetics and skins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36175280/041ee8bfd6a543f88c99fa09f35b5f67e402c42f.jpg[/img]

[b]Finally! you can play as the Ayuwoki! hunt down every last survivor to win the match![/b]
The Ayuwoki monster has special abilities to use as an advantage, visual hearing like a sonar, or echolocation!

Also throwing up biomass to create a sticky substance in the floor, or alarm rats, among other things!
You can also directly execute players with an "ultimate" skill (with a huge cooldown time of course).
Knock down closed doors to keep pursuing the survivors or to prevent them to shutting the doors in your face so they can escape.

[b]Play alongside your friends and don't let the Ayuwoki catch them! [/b]you are rewarded for helping your teammates, solving puzzles and working as a team to be able to escape the mansion.

[b]Each time you play re-live the experience of being lost in an unknown mansion![/b] since its randomly generated again and again each match! Puzzles will be also randomized and this time you can escape through different exit points and each one is a different challenge to solve.

[b]The Ayuwoki monster can be customized[/b] through a different variety of skins!
New skins are being added with each update, events and special hollidays!

[b]The survivors can be customized[/b] at will with different hairstyles, outfits, colors, etc!
In each update, event or special holliday new cosmetics are being added!
